tasks.title: Register the chat permission area and extend system roles
tasks.description: Add chat:read, chat:write, chat:moderate and chat:dm to permissions.ts and map each into SYSTEM_ROLES explicitly, without widening any existing role's non-chat permissions.

tasks.title: Add chat retention and socket origin configuration
tasks.description: Add chatRetentionDays (default 365) and the socket origin allow-list to config/env.ts, return them from readConfig, and document them in .env.example.

tasks.title: Create the ChatChannel model
tasks.description: Model kind enum, nameKey, project reference, participants, archived flag, lastMessageAt and lastMessageAuthor, with the unique name-key index.

tasks.title: Create the ChatMessage model with cursor index
tasks.description: Model author, parent, mentions, attachments, editedAt, deletedAt and pinnedAt, plus the (channel, createdAt, _id) index the paging predicate needs.

tasks.title: Create the ChatReaction model
tasks.description: One row per (message, user, emoji) enforced by a unique compound index so the reaction toggle has a single key.

tasks.title: Create the ChatRead model
tasks.description: Last-read pointer per (channel, user) with a unique compound index, used to derive unread badges.

tasks.title: Create the ChatPresence model with TTL
tasks.description: User-level presence carrying a connection counter and a TTL index on seenAt so an unclean disconnect ages out.

tasks.title: Implement pure channel access rules
tasks.description: Create utils/chatAccess.ts with visibility, write and moderation rules per channel kind; a direct-channel non-participant resolves to not_found.

tasks.title: Seed default channels and backfill project channels
tasks.description: Seed one team and one general channel per workspace and backfill project channels on list, tolerating a duplicate-key race the way syncProjectsFromTasks does.

tasks.title: Add the channel listing route
tasks.description: GET /channels behind protect, requirePermission('chat:read') and a validator chain, returning only channels the caller may read.

tasks.title: Create the project channel inside createProject
tasks.description: Hook channel creation into project creation, reusing an existing channel for the same project instead of inserting a duplicate.

tasks.title: Archive the project channel in the delete cascade
tasks.description: Extend the existing deleteProject cascade to archive the channel and its messages, leaving history readable and deleting no message rows.

tasks.title: Mount chat routes and add the chat rate limit
tasks.description: Mount the channels and chat routers under workspaceRoutes and add a dedicated chat limiter alongside the existing apiLimiter in app.ts.

tasks.title: Create the authenticated Socket.IO server
tasks.description: Build realtime/socket.ts and attach it to the HTTP server in server.ts, validating the handshake bearer token through the existing auth path and closing sockets of revoked sessions.

tasks.title: Validate socket payloads and throttle per connection
tasks.description: Validate every socket event payload with the same pure validators as REST and apply a per-connection token bucket so one client cannot flood a channel.

tasks.title: Implement message creation and broadcast
tasks.description: Authorize, normalise mentions, persist, then emit to the channel room excluding the author's connection, acknowledging only after a successful write.

tasks.title: Implement cursor-paginated message history
tasks.description: Expose GET /chat/:channelId/messages using the chatQuery cursor helpers with a hard page cap of 50.

tasks.title: Maintain the channel last-message pointer
tasks.description: Update lastMessageAt and lastMessageAuthor on write and order the channel list by them instead of scanning messages.

tasks.title: Implement the REST send fallback
tasks.description: Expose the same message creation over REST for clients without a socket, sharing the controller with the socket handler so authorisation has one implementation.

tasks.title: Implement threaded replies
tasks.description: Store replies with a parent reference and project reply count plus last replier onto the parent so the channel can show a summary.

tasks.title: Implement mentions and mention notifications
tasks.description: Resolve @mentions against workspace members through chatMentions, persist user references, and notify through the existing notify path rather than a parallel mechanism.

tasks.title: Implement reaction toggle and aggregation
tasks.description: Toggle a reaction keyed by (message, user, emoji) and broadcast the aggregated per-emoji state so all clients agree.

tasks.title: Implement author-only message edit
tasks.description: Allow the author to edit their own message, record editedAt, keep the original timestamp, and refuse edits by anyone else.

tasks.title: Implement soft delete with tombstone
tasks.description: Soft-delete on author or moderator deletion, clearing body and attachment references while retaining the row for ordering and reply integrity.

tasks.title: Implement message attachments
tasks.description: Wire uploads through the existing uploadMiddleware and GridFS helpers, enforce channel read access on download, and remove orphaned files when message creation fails.

tasks.title: Implement ephemeral typing events
tasks.description: Broadcast typing state without persisting it, expiring it on idle or when the message arrives.

tasks.title: Implement read state and unread derivation
tasks.description: Accept POST /chat/:channelId/read and derive unread counts from the stored last-read pointer.

tasks.title: Implement channel search
tasks.description: Search message text case-insensitively within the workspace, escaping the term before building its regex, paginating results and honouring channel read access.

tasks.title: Implement pinning and the pinned list
tasks.description: Allow callers with chat:write to pin and unpin a message and list a channel's pinned messages in pinned order.

tasks.title: Implement direct channel creation
tasks.description: Create or reuse the single direct channel between exactly two members so the same pair never accumulates duplicates.

tasks.title: Enforce non-disclosure for direct channels
tasks.description: Answer 404 for a direct channel the caller does not participate in, including for administrators, so the channel's existence is not revealed.

tasks.title: Implement moderator message deletion
tasks.description: Allow chat:moderate holders to delete any workspace message and record the action in the activity feed with actor and channel.

tasks.title: Enforce the configured retention window
tasks.description: Purge messages beyond chatRetentionDays and exclude purged content from search results.

tasks.title: Track user-level presence from connections
tasks.description: Count one presence per user across tabs and devices rather than per socket, and expose it to the channel header.

tasks.title: Refresh presence so stale entries age out
tasks.description: Refresh presence periodically so the TTL removes an unclean disconnect instead of leaving a user permanently shown as online.

tasks.title: Push activity changes to permission-filtered audiences
tasks.description: Emit activity-feed changes over the socket, computing the audience per permission with the existing hiddenActions helper so no group leaks to a caller who may not see it.

tasks.title: Replay missed events from the cursor on reconnect
tasks.description: After a reconnect, replay activity-feed events from the stored cursor with no gaps and no duplicates.

tasks.title: Expose transport state to the client
tasks.description: Deliver the connected or degraded transport state so chat and live updates report fallback mode instead of silently going stale.

tasks.title: Consume socket events in the live module
tasks.description: Update features/live to consume socket events while preserving merge and liveStore semantics and keeping the poller as the fallback path.

tasks.title: Scaffold the chat feature module
tasks.description: Create client/src/features/chat with index.ts as the public entry, api.ts calling through utils/api.ts, and shared types.

tasks.title: Implement the channel list hook
tasks.description: Build useChatChannels covering the channel list, unread counts and the seed trigger.

tasks.title: Implement cursor paging for messages
tasks.description: Build useChatMessages with cursor paging, prepending older pages without a scroll jump, and live append of incoming messages.

tasks.title: Build the channel view and composer
tasks.description: Render the header, message list and composer, rendering bodies as text or through the existing markdown path with no raw HTML injection.

tasks.title: Build the thread side panel
tasks.description: Render a parent's replies in order and accept new replies without navigating away from the channel.

tasks.title: Build the mention autocomplete
tasks.description: Offer workspace members when @ is typed and insert a mention that the API stores as a user reference.

tasks.title: Build the reaction bar
tasks.description: Show aggregated per-emoji counts with the reactor list and reflect the toggle immediately.

tasks.title: Build edit and delete affordances
tasks.description: Expose edit and delete only for the author, showing the edited marker and the tombstone after deletion.

tasks.title: Build the attachment picker and preview
tasks.description: Pick and upload files through the existing upload path, show name, size and type on the message, and surface validation errors.

tasks.title: Build typing and read indicators
tasks.description: Show who is typing and mark channels read when opened so the unread badge clears.

tasks.title: Build the search and pinned panels
tasks.description: Provide channel search results and a pinned-message list with navigation to the message.

tasks.title: Add the direct message entry point
tasks.description: Start a direct conversation from the channel list and open the created or reused channel.

tasks.title: Show presence in the channel header
tasks.description: Render online state in the header, treating one user with several connections as a single presence.

tasks.title: Make the chat surface accessible
tasks.description: Keyboard operation, an accessible name on every control, and a polite live region announcing incoming messages.

tasks.title: Make the chat layout mobile-first
tasks.description: Keep the chat surface usable in the existing mobile shell and tab bar without a separate mobile implementation.

tasks.title: Implement empty, loading, error and offline states
tasks.description: Cover no channel selected, no messages yet, history failure and degraded transport with explicit UI rather than a blank pane.

tasks.title: Add the CHAT group to the sidebar
tasks.description: Insert a CHAT group between Main Menu and General, fed from the same permission-filtered channel source as the other nav items.

tasks.title: Register the chat routes
tasks.description: Add /:workspaceSlug/chat and /:workspaceSlug/chat/:channelId under WorkspaceLayout behind PermissionRoute with chat:read.

tasks.title: Keep the mobile tab bar coherent
tasks.description: Ensure the new sidebar group stays coherent with the mobile tab bar navigation.

tasks.title: Extend the Vercel CSP for the socket origin
tasks.description: Add the socket origin and wss: scheme to connect-src in vercel.json, which currently allows 'self' only and blocks socket connections outright.

tasks.title: Source socket origins from validated config
tasks.description: Read the socket origin allow-list from config/env.ts rather than a literal and use wss: in production.

tasks.title: Confirm Helmet covers the chat surface
tasks.description: Verify the application-wide helmet middleware applies to chat HTTP routes and that the socket upgrade introduces no unprotected second HTTP surface.

tasks.title: Confirm validation coverage on routes and events
tasks.description: Check every chat route carries a validator chain and every socket event validates its payload, with no client input interpolated into a query operator.

tasks.title: Confirm no raw HTML injection in chat components
tasks.description: Audit the chat feature for dangerouslySetInnerHTML and confirm bodies render through the safe text or markdown path.

tasks.title: Run typecheck, lint, governance validation and manual checks
tasks.description: Run the server and client typecheckers, the client linter and node .sdrive/scripts/validate-governance.js, then manually check keyboard navigation, narrow screens and the connected versus degraded transport states.

tasks.title: Add the members list to the Project model
tasks.description: Adds a materialised members array with an index, initialised empty so existing projects keep working.

tasks.title: Implement pure project-membership helpers
tasks.description: Adds utils/projectMembers.ts for merging, de-duplicating and removing member ids, with no HTTP or database dependency.

tasks.title: Add an assignee to the project members on task assignment
tasks.description: Assigning a user to a task adds them to the owning project members, idempotently, without requiring a separate invitation.

tasks.title: Remove a departing member from every project
tasks.description: When a member leaves the workspace, remove them from every project members list so channel access ends with membership.

tasks.title: Gate project channels by project membership
tasks.description: Replace the projects:read gate with a membership check that answers 404 for a non-member and lets chat:moderate through.

phases.name: Team channel audience, naming and avatar

tasks.title: Add name override and avatar to the channel model
tasks.description: Adds nameOverride, avatarFileId and avatarType so a team channel can be renamed and re-pictured without touching the project.

tasks.title: Serve the team-channel list in one request
tasks.description: Returns each readable team channel with its avatar, display name, last-message preview and the caller unread state in a single aggregation.

tasks.title: Exclude project channels from main-menu navigation
tasks.description: The channels endpoint marks project channels as list-only so the sidebar shows just team and general while the chat screen shows the rest.

tasks.title: Allow a chat:moderate holder to rename a channel
tasks.description: PATCH renames a team channel, falls back to the project name when no override exists, and refuses everyone else with 403.

tasks.title: Allow a chat:moderate holder to set a channel avatar
tasks.description: Uploads an image through the existing upload pipeline into GridFS, keeps the previous avatar when a upload is rejected, and refuses everyone else.

tasks.title: Serve a channel avatar to readers only
tasks.description: Streams the avatar to callers who may read the channel and answers 404 otherwise.

tasks.title: Broadcast rename and avatar changes
tasks.description: Emits the updated channel to members with the channel open so a rename does not require a reload.

phases.name: Members navigation and team-channel list UI

tasks.title: Rename the Team navigation item to Members
tasks.description: Changes the sidebar label to Members and points it at the members path.

tasks.title: Route the directory at /members and redirect /team
tasks.description: Serves the team directory at /:workspaceSlug/members and redirects the previous /:workspaceSlug/team path so old links still resolve.

tasks.title: Limit the sidebar chat group to team and general
tasks.description: SidebarChannels lists only the team and general channels and no longer shows project channels.

tasks.title: Build the team-channel list
tasks.description: Adds the WhatsApp-style group list beside the conversation with avatar, name, last-message preview and unread dot.

tasks.title: Show an explicit empty state for the team list
tasks.description: When a caller can read no team channel the list says so rather than disappearing.

tasks.title: Build the channel settings dialog
tasks.description: Renders rename and avatar editing only for chat:moderate holders and hides it otherwise.

tasks.title: Wire the list into the chat screen
tasks.description: Composes the team list beside the conversation, opens the selected channel, and shows the archived read-only banner.

tasks.title: Make the new surfaces keyboard accessible
tasks.description: The team list, the settings dialog and the avatar picker are operable by keyboard with accessible names.

tasks.title: Lay the conversation out like a group chat
tasks.description: Own messages right-aligned without their own avatar; other members left-aligned with avatar and name, each bubble carrying time, edited and pinned marks.

tasks.title: Exclude the signed-in user from the mention menu
tasks.description: The suggestion list filters out the current user, since a self-mention has no effect.

tasks.title: Highlight mentions in the message body
tasks.description: Splits the body into text and mention runs, highlighting only tokens that match a known member, without injecting raw HTML.

tasks.title: Persist multiple attachments on a message
tasks.description: Resolves each attachment id to its stored name, size and type and refuses an id uploaded to a different channel.

tasks.title: Accept several files in the attachment picker
tasks.description: The picker takes a multi-file selection and uploads each independently so one rejection does not discard the rest.

tasks.title: Order the side panel as DMs then team channels
tasks.description: New direct message first, then the direct conversations, then the team channels.

tasks.title: Return server-side unread state per channel
tasks.description: Each channel reports whether it holds messages newer than the caller last visit, so the badge survives across devices.

tasks.title: Return an accurate per-channel member count
tasks.description: Workspace members for the default channels, project members for a team channel, two for a direct conversation.

tasks.title: Fix the task-creation nameKey validation error
tasks.description: Replaces the load-and-save membership hook with a single atomic updateOne so no full-document validation runs on a partially selected project.

tasks.title: Extract the shared conversation section
tasks.description: Splits heading, row anatomy, loading/empty copy, footline, unread marker and keyboard handling out of TeamChannelList into ConversationSection.

tasks.title: Render team channels through the shared section
tasks.description: TeamChannelList becomes a thin wrapper and keeps the rename and avatar settings affordance.

tasks.title: Add the direct-message section
tasks.description: DirectMessageList renders direct rows through ConversationSection with the other participant avatar and name.

tasks.title: Serve conversations in one request
tasks.description: Adds GET /chat/conversations returning { directs, teams } with previews and unread state; keeps GET /chat/teams.

tasks.title: Resolve a direct card from the other participant
tasks.description: Name and avatar come from the other participant User, with the neutral Direct message fallback.

tasks.title: Compose the panel order
tasks.description: Renders New direct message, then Direct messages, then Team channels, each with its own loading and empty copy.

tasks.title: Add a new conversation in place
tasks.description: A newly created direct conversation is inserted into the direct section and selected without a reload.

tasks.title: Extract the New direct message picker
tasks.description: Moves the picker out of ChannelList and removes the empty-list shim from the chat screen.

tasks.title: Verify the segmented panel
tasks.description: Runs typecheckers, lint and the governance validator, then checks the panel at 320px and by keyboard.

phases.name: Conversation list polish and honest counts

tasks.title: Order conversations by recency
tasks.description: Sorts both sections by lastMessageAt descending, never-used last, then by name, in the conversations query.

tasks.title: Return unread counts
tasks.description: Adds an unread count per card from ChatRead and caps the rendered value at 9+.

tasks.title: Patch a background conversation row
tasks.description: Uses the existing message socket event to update the row preview, count and position in place.

tasks.title: Rebuild the New direct message control
tasks.description: Renders a 44px row with icon, label and a labelled teammate list, keyboard operable with aria-expanded.

tasks.title: Add the creator to project members
tasks.description: Project creation adds the creator to Project.members idempotently.

tasks.title: Backfill the creator into existing projects
tasks.description: The channel backfill pass also adds missing creators to Project.members once.

tasks.title: Compute the count by channel kind
tasks.description: Project members including the creator, exactly two participants for direct, workspace members for the defaults.

tasks.title: Stop the workspace-count fallback
tasks.description: startDirect returns memberCount and the header no longer falls back to members.length.

tasks.title: Show the person in a direct header
tasks.description: A direct conversation header renders the other participant avatar and display name instead of a lock glyph.

tasks.title: Verify the control and the counts
tasks.description: Runs typecheckers, lint and the governance validator, then checks the 44px control at 320px and by keyboard.

tasks.title: Build the find bar
tasks.description: Renders the input, position counter, previous/next and close; opens on the header button and Ctrl/Cmd+F, closes on Esc.

tasks.title: Build the result list
tasks.description: A labelled listbox of option rows with author, date and highlighted snippet, bounded rows and a selection kept in view.

tasks.title: Add the search helpers
tasks.description: Pure nextIndex with wrapping, formatCounter and segmentSnippet that highlights by React nodes rather than HTML.

tasks.title: Replace the dropdown
tasks.description: Removes SearchPanel from the chat screen and composes the bar and the result list in its place.

tasks.title: Wire the keyboard contract
tasks.description: ArrowDown/ArrowUp wrap, Enter opens, Shift+Enter goes back, Esc closes; focus stays in the input with aria-activedescendant.

tasks.title: Page the results
tasks.description: Fetches the next cursor page when the selection reaches the last loaded row and drops stale responses.

tasks.title: Jump to the selected message
tasks.description: Closes search, loads older pages when the message is missing, scrolls to it and highlights it briefly; reports a deleted message.

tasks.title: Finish the accessibility pass
tasks.description: Polite counter announcement, visible focus ring and a selection cue that does not rely on colour alone.

tasks.title: Verify the find widget
tasks.description: Runs the typecheckers, lint and the governance validator, then keyboard-checks a term spanning two pages at 320px.

tasks.title: Perform the CON-703 browser pass on the chat routes
tasks.description: With a seeded local MongoDB, check the channel list, conversation, thread overlay and find widget at 320/768/1024px and by keyboard. Added by /sdrive:review on 2026-10-18.

tasks.title: Point the dashboard invite step at the Members route
tasks.description: Replace the retired /{slug}/team destination in the GetStartedChecklist invite step with /{slug}/members and update GetStartedChecklist.test.tsx to assert it. Added by /sdrive:review on 2026-10-19 for AC-036.

tasks.title: Document the chat surface in README
tasks.description: Add a README section covering how to reach chat, the chat:* permissions, and that search is channel-scoped and excludes thread replies. Added by /sdrive:review on 2026-10-19.
